item.description: Shares of computer chip equipment maker ASML dipped on Tuesday, the first trading day after U.S. lawmakers ‌last week proposed a law that could further restrict the ‌company's sales to China. ASML is the dominant maker of such tools that are ‌used to create the ⁠circuitry of chips, though it faces competition from Nikon of Japan and Chinese firm SMEE.
